card.name: "Until" after "or" in cancer treatment duration
card.fires_on: The word "until" right after "or" when a treatment duration is given, such as a number of cycles or weeks or until disease progression. Weaker hits are on word starts in oncology phrases like "Unresectable or Metastatic".

modes.label: Duration limit
modes.description: "until" follows "cycles or" or "weeks or" and introduces disease progression or toxicity as the stopping point.

modes.label: Start of a split cancer term
modes.description: The start of a word in a cancer heading, such as the R in RAS or Met in Metastatic.
